title: The Effects of Blood Pressure Reduction on Cerebral Perfusion and Cognition in the Elderly Population
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine if a reduction in systolic blood pressure induced by anti-hypertensive medication results in changes in cerebral perfusion and cognition in hypertensive elderly. Hypertensive elderly will be treated using open-label anti-hypertensive medication for 8-12 weeks. Changes in cerebral perfusion and cognition will be assessed before and after treatment.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age \>= 70 years
* Systolic office blood pressure \>= 160 mmHg
* Systolic home blood pressure \>= 155 mmHg

Exclusion Criteria:

* Diabetes Mellitus
* Atrial fibrillation
* Dementia
* Renal failure requiring dialysis
* Life expectancy of less than 1 year
* Disabling stroke
* Contraindication for MRI or anti-hypertensive medication
* Systolic blood pressure \> 220 mmHg
